instructions.manual_exchange_notice: Upload this CHATGPT_PACKAGE.json independently in a fresh chat. VideoHoarder never uploads data automatically.

quality_rubric.grounding: Every material transcript-derived conclusion cites canonical segment_ids.
quality_rubric.coverage: Process every exact VIDEO_ID and every requested feature.
quality_rubric.semantic_synthesis: Write semantic summaries that consolidate meaning, argument, method and implications; do not concatenate or lightly rewrite transcript lines.
quality_rubric.timeline: Create boundaries only when the substantive topic changes; merge adjacent fragments about the same point.
quality_rubric.claims: Extract all consequential factual, medical, safety, financial, legal, causal, quantitative and recommendation claims; grade risk and external-verification need.
quality_rubric.entities: Perform named-entity recognition, merge aliases, type entities using the controlled list, and omit generic nouns.
quality_rubric.taxonomy: Use only controlled categories and canonical non-promotional tags.
quality_rubric.editorial: Make assessments specific to this video's evidence, value, limitations and audience; never reuse boilerplate.
quality_rubric.consistency: Use the same canonical evidence across summaries, timeline, claims, intake and editorial assessment.
quality_rubric.specificity: Preserve useful names, quantities, steps and qualifications; avoid generic filler.
quality_rubric.uncertainty: Distinguish source claims, supplied support, interpretation and external-verification needs.
quality_rubric.comments: Cluster only structured supplied comment records and report total, included count and sampling limitations; popularity is not factual verification.
quality_rubric.clips: Select only self-contained clips lasting 30-180 seconds, with valid non-overlapping timestamps and a video-specific purpose.

instructions.instructions: Use only the evidence embedded in this independently processed package and obey response_schema.feature_contracts, controlled_taxonomy, and formal_json_schema. Process every exact VIDEO_ID and return one final JSON object with no prose or markdown. All features must use the same canonical sentence-level transcript segments. Do not claim that you watched or listened to a video. Produce semantic synthesis rather than extractive transcript rewrites. Build timelines from meaningful topic boundaries. Perform complete risk-aware claim extraction and proper named-entity recognition. Make editorial_assessment.v1 a video-specific ChatGPT's Take, not boilerplate. Separate: (1) what the source says, (2) what the supplied evidence supports, (3) your interpretation, and (4) what remains uncertain or requires external verification. Cite canonical transcript segment_ids for transcript-derived conclusions. Downgrade confidence for partial/low evidence. If canonical segments are absent, do not produce transcript-derived summaries, timelines, claims, transcript-derived entities, or clips; metadata/comment-derived fields must identify their source and unsupported fields must be empty/unknown with the limitation. Validate structure, semantics, provenance, duplicates, timestamps, word counts and cross-feature consistency before returning PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS or FAIL.

editorial_assessment.v1.chatgpt_take: A concise, evidence-grounded interpretation—not a repetition of the summary.

practical_value.explanation: Why the material is or is not useful.

credibility_assessment.explanation: Assess presentation and supplied support without pretending to externally fact-check.

editorial_assessment.v1.interpretation_limits: What cannot be concluded from the supplied evidence.
